name: Piecewise-Linear Haar Transform
definition: PLHaar is a wavelet transform used for compression that does not preserve averages, unlike Haar, CFH, and S transforms. It is interpreted as an involution involving rotations and flips.
summary: The Piecewise-Linear Haar Transform is a continuous wavelet transform that prevents fade-to-gray artifacts and enables lossless coding via a single lookup table for forward and inverse operations.
